exposure: surgical management of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) (modified one-step conservative uterine surgery (MOSCUS) vs. cesarean hysterectomy)
cohort: 296 pregnant women at more than 28 weeks of pregnancy with a diagnosis of PAS
finding: The MOSCUS procedure for managing placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) was associated with shorter surgical time, less blood loss, and fewer visceral injuries compared to cesarean hysterectomy, but a higher rate of postoperative infection.
